integrity_notes: The complete local ring assertion is established by an exact modulo-four obstruction plus finite-Hilbert-scheme arguments; finite-field enumeration is only a check and not a substitute for the general proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the coefficientwise integral diagonal Segre cubic over Z_2; it makes no assertion about the distinct characteristic-two modular model, other primes, or lines in place of planes. The cone and 27-plane special count are prior context, not novel claims.
title: The exact mixed-characteristic plane Hilbert scheme of the diagonal Segre cubic
